title: Sequencing: translation queue
bodyMd:
Five texts wait for translation. A translator completes them in a single sequence, one at a time.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Charter, Decree, Essay, Poem, Speech.

- Speech must be immediately followed by Decree.
- Essay must precede Charter.
- Poem must not be in position 1.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
